about: Which signature counts for an attested obligation, and what the portal's checklist shows, written from the rule (the newest signature neither dated in the future nor expired counts; a recurring signature expires on the catalogue's period whatever its expires_at says, or sooner if expires_at is earlier). Read by scripts/test/test_compliance_port.py (latest_valid) and portal/test/complianceState.test.ts (checklist), so the two cannot drift apart (the 4.1.0 review's second pass, P2-R20).

cases.name: an older live signature counts when the newest has expired (the review's case)
of two live signatures the newer counts
the catalogue's period ends a signature whose expires_at is later
within thirty days of its end a live signature is expiring
a signature dated in the future does not count, and is not shown
a one-off obligation's signature with no expiry counts for good
a one-off obligation's signature past its expires_at does not count
